question: Team ES2011's project manager said they would check what one of the new project requirements meant. What was the question, and what was the answer when it came up again?

steps.query: television only DVD check requirement answer
television only DVD meant internet check back

steps.answer: A (project manager) said she'd check whether 'television only' meant no DVD or just no internet features. At the next meeting she reported back that DVD was excluded too: the remote would not support DVD, only television.
